$schema: Discovery seed queries: (query, location) pairs in YOUR field, saved as data/queries/seeds.json in your workspace. `/jobe onboard` writes this from your target role titles and target locations, so after setup it reflects your actual search. It starts EMPTY on purpose: Jobe assumes nothing about your field. With no rows, discovery keeps every title and search driven sources are skipped. Row shape: { "query": "<a role title you want>", "location": "<a metro, or Remote>" }. Two rows from unrelated fields, to show the shape only: { "query": "Registered Nurse", "location": "Remote" } and { "query": "Tax Accountant", "location": "Denver, CO" }.
